item.title: commaMenu
item.description: Type commaMenu to open the compact type-based context menu. License Manager is on this menu and runs commaRegister.

item.title: Installing
item.description:
CommaRh installs from Rhino’s Package Manager. There is no separate installer to download.

  1. Open Rhino 8 on Windows.
  2. Run PackageManager.
  3. Search for CommaRh.
  4. Click Install.

This guide matches CommaRh 26.1.8. Package Manager shows the version that is installed.

After install, run commaMenu.

item.title: uIfcExport
item.description:
Where to find it: commaMenu → IFC → uIfcExport.

Export selected objects to IFC. Default SitePlacement=Local (OpenBIM). The command seeds missing SitePlacement / MapConversion values into Document User Text.

Run uIfcSetupTemplateFile before a serious export. It seeds the layer tree and the standard Document User Text keys. Check or edit those keys in Document Properties → User Text.

Key Default Meaning
IFC.SitePlacement Local Site Z = 0. Engineering elevation stays on the object. Storey Placement Z is the storey Elevation. Anchor, Mean, and Legacy anchor the site at the mean XYZ (older behavior).
IFC.Storey.{Building}.{Storey}.Elevation or IFC.Storey.{Storey}.Elevation min Z if unset Storey elevation. The name must match segment 4 of the layer path.
IFC.MapConversion.Eastings / Northings / OrthogonalHeight seeded when Local and empty or 0 Georeference. 0 or missing means unset, so a Local export writes mean XY / mean Z (or IFC.Offset.Z).
IFC.Offset.X / Y / Z 0 Geometry offset. Independent of MapConversion.
IFC.Schema IFC4 IFC4, IFC2X3, or IFC4X3.
IFC.UseBridge off True with schema IFC4X3 uses IfcBridge / IfcBridgePart.

If the file was not set up yet, uIfcExport reads the selected Project::Site::Building::Storey::… layer tree and writes only the Document User Text keys that are still missing. It does not overwrite existing values. After the export, open Document Properties → User Text to edit them.

Property types live in the key. See uIfcApplySharedParams.

item.title: uMeshToNurbs
item.description:
Where to find it: commaMenu → Mesh → uMeshToNurbs.

Convert meshes to NURBS; keeps attributes. Quality Fast/Balanced/Tight (default Balanced: faceted + analytic for prism/tubes/circular holes, auto-heal). Output Replace/Copy. Advanced=Yes shows Mode/Method/Tolerance/HealOpen/…. Free/Trial: 50 meshes per run. Rotational parts (bolts, shafts, rings) become real cylinders/cones; multi-piece meshes convert piece by piece and unconvertible pieces stay meshes (PARTIAL).

item.title: Using the menu
item.description:
Run commaMenu to open the type menu.

Group What it covers
Doc Layers, objects, attributes, visibility, sort, scope box, tolerance, quick tools
Curve Curve scale, direction, conversion, and circle or arc fitting
Surface Surface normal
Brep Scale, loft, smooth, combine, and face extraction
Mesh Patch, mesh to NURBS, and 2D outline
Drafting Blocks, section, annotation, hatch, and measurements
CAD DWG import and export
IFC IFC import, export, template, shared parameters, and IfcOpenShell

commaMenu also includes License Manager, which runs commaRegister.

Commands that are not on the menu are still public. Type the command name. Each of those pages says so.

item.title: License
item.description:
Where to find it: commaMenu → License Manager, or type commaRegister.

commaRegister opens Comma License Manager for this computer. It shows the Machine ID (with Copy), the current status, and a license key box.

A computer without a key runs a 45-day trial. No sign-up is required. The customer line then reads “This computer (no sign-up)”. Status reads Trial with the days left, Trial - last day on the final day, Licensed for an active Pro key, or Unlicensed when the trial is over and no key is active.

To activate a key, paste it into License key or use Browse…, then click Activate. Remove clears the key stored on this computer.

For Pro, more seats, or a key for another computer, use Contact us to get a license or write to comma3d.aec@gmail.com.

Do not paste a license key into a GitHub issue.

item.title: uIfcSetupTemplateFile
item.description:
Where to find it: commaMenu → IFC → uIfcSetupTemplateFile.

Create an IFC template: layer hierarchy, Document User Text (including IFC.SitePlacement=Local), built-in shared parameters, and samples.

The layer tree is Project::Site::Building::Storey::…. Document User Text also receives IFC.SharedParam.*[Type]. The command creates a TypeCatalog_Sample object with one sample key for each property-type token.

Run this command before a serious IFC workflow, then review Document Properties → User Text. The key table and the export fallback are on uIfcExport.

item.title: Report a problem
item.description:
Problems are tracked on CommaRh Issues.

Include:

  • The installed CommaRh version shown in Package Manager
  • The Rhino 8 version
  • The command name
  • What you expected and what happened

Leave license keys out of the issue. For a new key, use commaRegister or comma3d.aec@gmail.com.

item.title: uIfcApplySharedParams
item.description:
Where to find it: commaMenu → IFC → uIfcApplySharedParams.

Apply IFC.SharedParam.*[Type]. The type is in the Key (YesNo or IfcBoolean, IfcIdentifier, …) and the Value is user data.

Document shared parameters use IFC.SharedParam.<ObjectKey>[Type]. Object User Text uses <ObjectKey>[Type]. Export strips the […] from the property name and writes an IfcPropertySingleValue with that nominal type.

Right: Dimensions.QTO.Area[Area] = 12.5
Right: Pset_WallCommon.IsExternal[YesNo] = False
Right: Spec.Code[IfcIdentifier] = W-01
Wrong: Spec.Flag = True[IfcBoolean]
Token in […] IFC nominal value Example value
Text / IfcLabel IfcLabel Sample label
IfcText IfcText a long string
IfcIdentifier IfcIdentifier ID-001@tag
YesNo / IfcBoolean IfcBoolean Yes / True / False
IfcLogical IfcLogical True
Integer / IfcInteger IfcInteger 42
Number / IfcReal IfcReal 3.14
Length / IfcLengthMeasure IfcLengthMeasure 1.25 (metres)
Area / IfcAreaMeasure IfcAreaMeasure 12.5
Volume / IfcVolumeMeasure IfcVolumeMeasure 0.75
IfcDate IfcDate 2026-11-07
IfcDateTime IfcDateTime 2026-11-07T16:00:00
IfcTime IfcTime 16:00:00
IfcDuration IfcDuration P1D
IfcURIReference IfcURIReference https://…
IfcDescriptiveMeasure IfcDescriptiveMeasure approx 2 m
IfcTimeStamp IfcTimeStamp unix seconds

uIfcSetupTemplateFile creates TypeCatalog_Sample with one key for each token.
